hook: → 观点卡：AI 资本开支回报率与市场波动性政变
lines: Barclays' Alexander Altmann notes that recent extreme equity market volatility and violent rallies are largely driven by technical mechanics such as negative dealer gamma and levered ETF liquidations rather than fundamental improvements.
Altmann highlights that the market has entered a new volatility regime requiring investors to recalibrate expectations for daily price fluctuations of two percent or more.
The hosts discuss how fundamental concerns regarding AI capital expenditure return on investment and infrastructure overcapacity remain unresolved despite short-term price rebounds.
The conversation emphasizes that the U.S. government's reliance on the stock market for household wealth creation acts as a de facto policy put to support critical sectors like AI.
title: What Jensen Huang's Stunning Return Means for the AI Trade
